scientific.integrity: The primary M-curvature article and the relevant thesis pages were materially inspected. Candidate-specific semantic and exact-formula searches covered the invariant, the two residue families, and equivalent translated-intersection language. The proof is analytic; the bundled finite computation independently reconstructs the definition only as a regression check.
limitations: The formulas cover only the two even regular-polygon residue families highlighted in the prior M-curvature literature.
The global conjecture that the regular decagon maximizes M-curvature among all centrally symmetric convex domains is not proved.
The exact decagon value is a prior-covered specialization, not a new result.
An unindexed elementary computation of the same all-family formulas remains a historical originality risk.

title: Exact M-curvature of the two exceptional regular-polygon families
